{{Quote|I have you now!|[[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]|<ref name="Outgunned">{{TCWComicCite|6.20|Outgunned}}</ref>}}
The '''''Xanadu Blood''''' was a heavily modified [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|''Rogue''-class starfighter]], given to [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==History==
[[File:XanaduBloodCockpit-CotF.png|thumb|left|220px|Cad Bane in the cockpit of ''Xanadu Blood'' with Wee Dunn]]
The Confederacy of Independent Systems gave the ''Xanadu Blood'' to the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] on behalf of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Bane first mentioned the ''Xanadu Blood''{{'s}} origin in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] when he was contacted by Sidious via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] inside the Duros' hideout on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After suggesting for a heavily modified [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], Sidious agreed to the bounty hunters demands. First using his fighter on the planet [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]], Bane [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|encountered]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tyzen Xebec]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ganch]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and fired the ''Xanadu Blood''{{'s}} [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] at the Republic force.

After Devaron, Sidious gave the bounty hunter a new assignment: capture potential [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] infants and bring them to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Bane used the ''Xanadu Blood'' to deliver infants from [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]], [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to Mustafar&mdash;for Sidious. However, while the bounty hunter was about to capture [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] [[Roo-Roo Page/Legends|Roo-Roo Page]] on Naboo, he was [[Attempted kidnapping of Roo-Roo Page/Legends|captured]] by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his Padawan, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Along with Bane, the ''Xanadu Blood'' was brought onboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. The fighter was examined by Skywalker and Tano to find clues about Bane's kidnapping mission. However, prior to being captured, Bane erased the fighter's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] records, although the two Jedi found out that Bane visited Mustafar sometime during his mission by finding volcanic ash on the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the ''Xanadu Blood''.

Sometime afterward, Bane retrieved the ship from the Republic. He would use it to land on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to receive payment for stealing the floor plans of the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]. Bane later used the ''Xanadu Blood'' to travel to the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] to present [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] to the Hutts after he [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|freed]] the corrupt Hutt. Bane and [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]] then traveled in the ship to [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] to recapture Ziro, and faced [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]. After a fierce duel, Todo and Bane returned to the ship and escaped, the Jedi forced to jump off and hang from the edge of the stone platform as it took off and hindered their pursuit.

Later in the war, Bane used the starfighter to pursue [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] Skywalker and Kenobi from [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] to an [[Republic repair yard|abandoned repair yard]] in the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]].<ref name="Outgunned">{{TCWComicCite|6.20|Outgunned}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Xanadu Blood'' first appeared in the episode "[[Children of the Force]]" of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. "Xanadu" in the English language refers to an idyllic place, originating from the 1816 poem [[Wikipedia:Kubla Khan|''Kubla Khan'']] by [[Wikipedia:Samuel Taylor Coleridge|Samuel Taylor Coleridge]] that was inspired by [[Wikipedia:Shangdu|Shangdu]], the summer capital of the [[Wikipedia:Mongols|Mongol]]-led [[Wikipedia:Yuan dynasty|Yuan dynasty]] in [[Wikipedia:China|China]] during the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries.<ref name="Capital">{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Xanadu|text=Xanadu|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20241203202723}}</ref>
